What is NanoPolix?

NanoPolix is a revolutionary, non-abrasive car detailing cloth infused with cutting-edge nanotechnology that fuses with your vehicle’s clear coat to permanently restore a flawless, factory-deep shine.

How does NanoPolix work?

According to our research, the cloth utilizes active nano-metal powder that penetrates the paint at a molecular level, filling gaps and bonding with the clear coat to physically erase damage and seal the surface.
